title: cardamine maxima
intro: Cardamine maxima, commonly known as large-flowered bitter-cress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine maxima are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit analgesic and anti-pyretic properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
